name: Joker’s Million

features.name: Expanding wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand after completing a win.

features.name: Two scatter types
features.description: Blue and red scatters with different pay rules.

review:
A 100-line fruit slot run by a ringmaster Joker, with stacked symbols, expanding wilds and a gamble round.

Wilds only land on reels 2 to 4, and when one completes a win it expands over its reel, which can set off more wins. There are blue and red scatters with different pay rules. Medium-high volatility, a 3,000x max and an outstanding 97.34% RTP. A great-value pick for classic fans.
pros: Excellent 97.34% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
